mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 27 degrees with clear skies observed at the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are currently under a First Quarter moon.

City updates include important notices for the upcoming November 2026 General Election and a reminder that pending development projects like the Sub-Zero site plan are currently under review by the Plan Commission.

Looking at our local calendar, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a full lineup of trivia nights and live music starting tomorrow at venues like Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation where a driver was found passed out at an intersection, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
It is a great day to enjoy our flavor of the day, Chocolate Volcano, and you can head over when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
